## Data

| File | Source | Used in |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `data/tourist_data.xlsx` | Statistics South Africa, *Tourist Accommodation* (P6410), <https://www.statssa.gov.za/?page_id=1854&PPN=P6410> | Projects 1 and 3 |
| `data/usdzar_fred.csv` | FRED series DEXSFUS (daily rand per US dollar), <https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DEXSFUS> | Project 2 |
| `data/usdzar_monthly_fred.csv` | FRED series EXSFUS (monthly average rand per US dollar), <https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/EXSFUS> | Project 3 |

The two FRED files are downloaded automatically the first time the relevant project is rendered and saved in the `data/` folder. All data are public, aggregated statistics with no personal information, so POPIA does not apply.

## Reproducing the portfolio

1. Install R, Quarto (version 1.4 or later) and the packages listed below.
2. Open the portfolio folder (or `portfolio.Rproj` in RStudio).
3. Run `quarto render` in the terminal, or use **Build > Render Website** in RStudio.

Computational results are stored in the `_freeze` folder, so pages are only re-run when their source changes.

## R packages


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
install.packages(c("fpp3", "readxl", "knitr", "rmarkdown", "patchwork", "rugarch"))
```
:::
